description: Hi, I'm Sarthak! Sole Winner of MoES (SIH25204) at SIH '25. I am a passionate AI & Hardware dev who loves bringing code to the physical world. My projects: Autonomous UGVs, Jal Jeevan IoT nodes, AquaSENSE, and Vision AI. Tech Stack: ROS 2, OpenCV, ESP32, Python, 3D Printing. For "Field Shift", I'm building a physical Smart Agri-Node fusing NASA data with edge telemetry. I’d love to team up with folks skilled in UI/UX or Cloud/APIs to build something amazing together!
summary:
Project Field Shift (RituChakra) is a proactive farm adaptation engine that bridges the critical gap between macro-level satellite climatology and micro-level agricultural reality. We developed a dynamic Streamlit-based dashboard powered by a fusion of NASA POWER and SMAP satellite datasets with hyper-local, in-situ telemetry from a custom ESP32 Community Automatic Weather Station (AWS) node.

To address the challenge of unpredictable climate volatility, our edge-computing hardware calculates real-time barometric pressure differentials (ΔP/3h) and dew point depression to trigger localized "Bird Effect" convective storm early warnings. This architecture directly downscales generic 10km satellite grids to precise, Panchayat-level ground truth.

This system is vital because it translates complex thermal trends and Growing Degree Days (GDD) into actionable, data-driven crop rotation strategies—such as timeline shifts, short-duration escape crops, or nitrogen-fixing legumes. By combining Sentinel-1 SAR waterlogging alerts with localized sensor fusion, RituChakra safeguards farmer livelihoods against terminal heat and sudden weather extremes.
details:
RituChakra (Project Field Shift) is a proactive farm adaptation engine that solves the critical gap between macro-level satellite forecasting and micro-level farm reality. It works by combining regional datasets from NASA POWER (climatology) and NASA SMAP (soil moisture) with live in-situ telemetry from a custom-built ESP32 Community AWS Node. Our edge hardware calculates barometric pressure differentials (ΔP/3h) and dew point depression to trigger localized "Bird Effect" convective storm warnings, giving farmers 2-4 hours of crucial lead time before sudden cloudbursts.

Tech Stack:

  • Hardware: ESP32 Dev Module, BME280 (Temperature/Pressure/Humidity), Capacitive Soil Moisture Sensor.
  • Software: C++ (Arduino IDE) for edge processing, Python & Streamlit for the data visualization dashboard, JSON/HTTP for middleware communication.
  • Satellites: NASA POWER, NASA SMAP, and ESA Sentinel-1 SAR.

Impact & Creativity: The core innovation is our Sensor Fusion architecture. By weighting satellite data (25%) with local ground-truth node data (75%), we reduced the prediction Mean Absolute Error (MAE) from 2.4°C down to 0.6°C. Instead of just showing weather, our engine translates this precision data into a 3-Tier Adaptive Rotation strategy (Smart Baseline, Climate Escaper, Soil & Wealth Builder) to save farmer livelihoods from terminal heat stress, waterlogging, and erratic monsoons.
